pyramiding_rule: Strictly prohibit adding to losing positions; pyramiding is only authorized after existing position achieves a minimum +$5.00 unrealized profit and trailing stop hits breakeven.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require a minimum 3-candle ATR confirmation and zero high-impact liquidity sweeps within the immediate 5-minute window before order placement.
profit_harvest_threshold: Trigger aggressive partial profit-taking at +$15.00 and lock remaining runner stops to ensure absolute $15-$30+ asymmetry.
